content_fields.title: Test that the Docker daemon and its files are audited (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that the Docker daemon and its files are being audited.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the audit rules are loaded, touching an audited path and observing the resulting record arrive in central log storage.
content_fields.found: No audit rules are defined in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Access to the host audit configuration and the log pipeline.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification is performed against host instrumentation.
content_fields.action: The platform team should verify audit coverage on each container host.
